headline: Oberoi Realty Limited: Outcome of Board Meeting
sum: Outcome of Board Meeting — Oberoi Realty Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on May 8, 2026-Board approves proposal for enabling raising of funds for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 4,000 Crore…
detail: Outcome of Board Meeting — Oberoi Realty Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on May 8, 2026-Board approves proposal for enabling raising of funds for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 4,000 Crore by way of issuance of non-convertible debentures by way of private placement
